ice_hunt.narration.1: The storm is over, and the sky is clear again! We need to plan our water supply.
ice_hunt.narration.2: Time for an ice hunt! I’m sending the rover out.
ice_hunt.dialogue.1: A short trip is safe. A long trip finds more ice, but the rover uses more power.
ice_hunt.dialogue.2: Look, a rover! That’s Curiosity. It has explored Gale Crater since 2012!
ice_hunt.dialogue.4: Curiosity says: Welcome to the neighborhood!
ice_hunt.question: How far should the rover go?
ice_hunt.A.label: Short trip (Life +8, Power −5)
ice_hunt.A.after: The rover found a little ice close to base. Not a lot, but it was a safe trip.
ice_hunt.B.label: Long trip (Life +18, Power −15, Shield −5)
ice_hunt.B.after: Lots of water! But the long trip used a lot of power and kept us outside longer, where there is more radiation.
ice_hunt.C.label: Ration the water (Life −3)
ice_hunt.C.after: We saved power by staying home, but our water is getting low. We will need a plan soon.
ice_hunt.classroom: What did the rover trip give us, and what did it use?
ice_hunt.cargo.rover_fuel: Our extra rover supply reduced this trip’s power cost.
